digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Rebar has no aggregation layer to trend agent-driven dev loop metrics over time despite rich event-sourced history in tickets branch and gate sidecars.

Three tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (caused_by), and bug outcome classification (close_class), requiring passive instrumentation via trustworthy code.
Blame-derivation for caused_by auto-links must bypass closed-source guards by writing directly to graph._links after bug transition commits, then label results as best-effort classified confidence.
Metrics snapshots must be stored in git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson rather than gitignored reports/ to persist across syncs.
Bug-close CLI must replace (not supplement) free-text --reason with bounded --class enum, keeping required-argument count flat at one.
Metrics command must emit all registered keys with either a value or unavailable state carrying reason and accruing_since, with no missing keys in JSON output.
